authorityRule: src/game/content.ts is the intended player-facing contract; runtime code and tests must be reconciled to it before 7.4C exits.
recognitionRule: A single or dominant boon should be identifiable within five seconds by stable silhouette, motion, impact/status and Special identity. Mixed builds show one dominant body plus at most two bounded attachments.

runtimeIdentity.dominantSelection: highest stack; ties prefer starting boon, then most recently increased boon, then roster order
runtimeIdentity.highStackRule: consolidate presentation without deleting simulation damage, targets or proc results
